issues: 没有导出时长常量，工作台按 56f 推断，末字刚落定画面就结束，没有收尾静止
左上角调试标题 "SPLIT TEXT STAGGER" 直接上屏
#ececea 纯色平铺 + Helvetica 800，标题像默认样式
字从裁切线下升起全程锐利，快速段没有速度感；基线是固定 920px 的 2px 灰线，与文字行宽度对不上
changes: 补 SPLIT_TEXT_STAGGER_DURATION = 130f（56f 动作 + 74f 静止），原节拍（12f 起跳、i×2f、115%→-10%→0）不变
去掉调试标题，柔光 Backdrop 替代纯色底
系统 SF 栈 700、字号 120→136、-0.015em 字距、带色相近黑墨色
每字按竖向速度加 SVG y 向运动模糊（≤10px，静止为 0）
基线改 3px 强调色渐变线、宽度与文字行严格等宽，生长改 30f 强 ease-out
issuesEn: No exported duration: the workbench guessed 56f, so the shot ended the instant the last letter landed with no hold
Debug label "SPLIT TEXT STAGGER" printed top-left
Flat #ececea fill and Helvetica 800, the title looked like a default style
Letters rose from the mask line razor sharp with no sense of speed; the baseline was a fixed 920px grey rule that did not match the text width
changesEn: Added SPLIT_TEXT_STAGGER_DURATION = 130f (56f action + 74f hold); original beats (12f start, i×2f, 115%→-10%→0) untouched
Debug label removed; soft-light Backdrop instead of a flat fill
SF system stack at 700, size 120→136, -0.015em tracking, tinted near-black ink
Per-letter vertical SVG motion blur from rise speed (≤10px, zero at rest)
Baseline is now a 3px accent gradient rule exactly as wide as the text, grown with a 30f strong ease-out
